name: Animate Dead
clause: When ~ enters, if it's on the battlefield, it loses "enchant creature card in a graveyard" and gains "enchant creature put onto the battlefield with ~." Return enchanted creature card to the battlefield under your control and attach ~ to it. When ~ leaves the battlefield, that creature's controller sacrifices it.

needs.proposedSignature: StaticEffect aura: { enchant: TargetSpec (already), enchantAfterEtb?: TargetSpec }  ·  Effect: { op: 'attach-self', target: Ref }  ·  TriggerEvent: { on: 'ltb', self: true } binding the previously attached object as `that`
needs.semantics: The Animate Dead pattern: an Aura that legally enchants a card in a graveyard, returns it and re-attaches itself, and whose leaves-the-battlefield trigger can still name the creature it was attached to. `attach-self` takes a TargetSpec only, and no binding survives the Aura leaving.
